- Orange: rows 26-27, cols 41-42
- Yellow: rows 37-40, cols 40-43
The path from blue to orange is clear (just RIGHT x 1 to reach cols 40-43, which overlaps with orange at cols 41-42).
But to reach yellow, I need to go DOWN from rows 25-28 to rows 37-40 at cols 40-43. Looking at the ASCII:
- Row 29: ...BBBBgggg (cols 36-39 = BBBB, cols 40-43 = gggg)

So from blue at cols 36-39, I can't go DOWN directly. I need to go RIGHT first to cols 40-43, then try to go DOWN.
Looking at rows 29-32, cols 40-43: gggg (clear)
Rows 33-36, cols 40-43: gggg (clear)
Row 37: ...rBrrYYYY (cols 40-43 = YYYY)
Wait, but the bottom area seems filled with obstacles. Let me look more carefully:
Row 37: BBrBrrrBrrrBrrrBrrrBrrYYYYBB
Row 38: BBrrBrrrBrrrBrrrBrrrBrYRRYBB
So at row 37, cols 40-43 is YYYY (yellow). But rows 33-36, cols 40-43 are gggg (clear).
So the path should be: RIGHT (to collect orange), then DOWN x 3 (to reach yellow).
But wait, I already tried DOWN and it had no impact. Let me check where I am now.
Blue is at rows 25-28, cols 36-39. The orange is at rows 26-27, cols 41-42.
So I need RIGHT x 1 to get to cols 40-43, which overlaps with orange.
Then from rows 25-28, cols 40-43, I need to go DOWN to reach yellow at rows 37-40, cols 40-43.
Looking at the path:
- rows 29-32, cols 40-43: gggg (clear)
- rows 33-36, cols 40-43: gggg (clear)
- rows 37-40, cols 40-43: YYYY (yellow)
So the path is: RIGHT, DOWN, DOWN, DOWN.
Let me try this.
